pages.text: Al-Cu-Fe melts near 63% aluminium can freeze into an icosahedral quasicrystal - ordered, but never repeating. Cool too slowly and the atoms have time to find an ordinary crystal; too fast and they freeze as a glass. Five-fold order forms only in between, and only near the right ratio.
$(thing)Set$(): Cooling rate (log₁₀ K/s), Aluminium fraction.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Wheel speed: the cooling rate varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): One cast at a time.
